c.description:
📞 CONTACT: show contact info for fast reply

Bright corner 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home on a high floor of One Burrard Place, Downtown Vancouver's landmark tower by IBI Group. Wraparound floor-to-ceiling windows frame city, False Creek and mountain views, and the split-bedroom layout gives everyone their own private space. Residents enjoy the 30,000 sq.ft. Club One amenity centre.

Highlights:
📍 Unit 40XX, 1289 Hornby St, Vancouver BC V6Z 0G7
🏠 2 Bedrooms | 2 Bathrooms | approx. 883 sq.ft.
🌆 Corner unit with city, False Creek & mountain views
🛏️ Split-bedroom layout + private balcony
🍳 Gaggenau kitchen with gas cooktop & stone waterfall island
❄️ Air conditioning
🛁 Marble bathrooms with heated floors — soaker tub + walk-in shower
🪵 Engineered hardwood throughout
🧺 Bosch washer & dryer in suite
📦 Large walk-in storage room
🅿️ 1 parking + 1 storage locker included
💡 Water & gas included
🚭 No smoking | 🐾 No pets

Club One Amenities:
🏊 Indoor pool, hot tub, sauna & steam room
🏋️ Fitness centre & yoga studio
🛎️ 24-hour concierge
🍷 Lounge, private dining, wine lockers, music & study rooms

Location Perks:
🏖️ Short walk to Sunset Beach, English Bay & the Seawall
🌉 Burrard Bridge at your doorstep — quick ride to Kitsilano
🚇 About 10 min walk to Yaletown-Roundhouse Station (Canada Line)
🚌 Buses on Burrard & Granville St
⛴️ Aquabus to Granville Island nearby
🛍️ Yaletown, Davie St & Granville St dining and shopping

NOTE: Credit check and paystubs required. Minimum 1 year lease.
